name: CORAL COVE
design_intent:
DROPSHOT variation — CORAL COVE, the WIDE long-rally court (sibling of dropshot_beach). Same STRUCTURE as beach: an enclosed symmetric court split by a solid centre NET; the floor is a row of ball-only destructible DROP_TILES; two hidden under-floor goal_zone strips team-tagged to the DEFENDING half score when the floaty beach ball breaks through. Only the geometry/theme changed vs beach: a WIDER court (half-court 1260px vs beach 1110) and MORE, slightly narrower tiles (12 tiles of 210 vs beach's 10 of 222) so rallies run longer before they reach the wall. Teal/turquoise reef palette (distinct from beach's #1d6fae/#ffca7a).

FANTASY-FIT (GAME_ESSENCE): the NET keeps beach's owner-tuned height — it rises 490px above the floor (y860..1350) leaving a 650px top gap; trampoline apex is ~270px so crossing to attack still favours boost (Verb: FLY) but the floaty ball lofts over the gap readily (owner 2026-07-18: never make the net taller than beach). Half-court width 1260px > 527px max spring drift, so pressing the ball to the far tiles REQUIRES flight — the wider court leans harder on the jetpack than beach does, which is the point of the variation. Hitting the ball is the existing bounce/drive contact physics; a super still doubles the strike (the power spike).

GEOMETRY: bounds 0..3100 x 0..1600. Interior x290..2810 (width 2520; half-court 1260). Ceiling bumper x200..2900 at y130..210. Side walls bumper x200..290 / x2810..2900 down to y1350. NET: bumper column x1535..1565 (centre 1550), y860..1350 (490px tall; the 650px top gap is fly-over). FLOOR: 12 drop_tiles of 210x100 at y1350 spanning x290..2810 (6 per half; the x1550 tile seam sits exactly under the net so no tile straddles the halves); two solid bumper caps seal the wall feet (x200..290, x2810..2900). UNDER-FLOOR: two hidden goal_zone strips y1455..1585 (team 0 left centre x920 / team 1 right centre x2180, each 1260 wide, mouth up). Hole clearance: tile 210 vs beach-ball diameter 168.
